$description: Material (dark appearance, pointer tier) — standalone W3C DTCG 2025.10 tokens.

sharedDos: Read all colors, radii, typography, and surface finishes through theme roles (`colors.*`, `shape.*`, `font.*`, `finish.*`) rather than literals in component code.
Read theme getters inside JSX render expressions or reactive effects so runtime theme switching (`selectTheme`) and light/dark appearance changes take effect on the next frame.
Use `rounded(shape.<role>, inset)` for concentric nested radii inside cards, switches, and segmented controls.
sharedDonts: Never write color literals (`#...`, `rgb()`, `oklch()`) in component, lib, or demo-adapter code.
Never store `colors.*`, `finish.*`, or `shape.*` values in module-level constants; they freeze on theme or appearance switches.
Never delete finish fields or alter the merged finish key set across appearances or themes.
designMd.voiceOmitted: Voice & Content Strategy is intentionally omitted: this theme defines visual tokens, surface finishes, typography metrics, and motion physics only; product copy, tone, capitalization, and terminology belong to the host application.
designMd.overview: Material 3 Expressive (`material-web` v34.0.21 / Compose Material 3 1.5.0) built from the `#6750A4` baseline with tonal surface containers, Expressive Tone 30 `on*Container` roles, state-layer overlays, and Expressive spatial/effects springs.
designMd.elevation: Tonal surface stepping plus Material Web Level 1–3 shadows and `material.android.elevation` (1dp/3dp/6dp), with `stroke.surface: 0px` and no backdrop blur.
dos: Express interaction states via M3 state-layer ink overlays (`hover: 0.08`, `focus: 0.10`, `pressed: 0.10`, `dragged: 0.16`) and Android press ripples (`state.ripple: true`) with `state.press-scale: 1`.
Use `shape.curve: "circular"` and `controls: "material"` for top-rounded underlined fields and underlined tabs.
Keep `stroke.surface: 0px` on tonal/elevated containers so depth comes from tonal steps and elevation.
donts: Do not add backdrop blur (`backdropFilter`) or surface borders (`stroke.surface > 0`) to M3 tonal surfaces.
Do not replace `outline` focus rings (`3px` width, `2px` offset) with halo rings.

in-cubic.$description: Exact cubic-bezier equivalent of NSH Easing.in(Easing.cubic).

decelerate.$description: WinUI 3 Fast Out, Slow In curve (entering elements).

accelerate.$description: WinUI 3 Slow Out, Fast In curve (exiting elements).

detail.$description: Sidebar section labels, counts, and supporting metadata.

body.$description: Standard body copy, list rows, and dialog content.

label.$description: Control labels, form labels, and interactive triggers.

display.$description: Large display numerals and hero headings.

dimension.$description: Desktop pointer layout density, control geometry, and icon sizes.

shape.$description: Semantic corner radius roles by layer, referencing base dimension.radius.* tokens.

control.$description: Corner radius for in-page elements: buttons, fields, rows, chips, badges, wells, color areas, and kbd.

container.$description: Corner radius for containers and overlays: cards, menus, popovers, tooltips, list panels, toasts, and frames.

modal.$description: Corner radius for modal surfaces: dialogs, sheets, and drawers.

hairline.$description: Hairline divider and outlined-variant stroke width.

surface.$description: 0px surface outline (M3 elevated/filled surfaces rely on elevation rather than outlines).

focus.$description: M3 focus indicator: 3px solid outline offset 2px (_md-sys-state-focus-indicator.scss).

offset.$description: 2px outward focus indicator offset per M3.

radius.$description: Material 3 Expressive corner scale (Compose tokens at `ac364f3c`: 4px CornerExtraSmall control, 12px CornerMedium/CornerLarge container, 28px CornerExtraLarge modal; capsule buttons via `shape.corners.button: "full"`).

control.$description: Corner radius for in-page controls, fields, rows, chips, badges, wells, color areas, and kbd.

container.$description: Corner radius for cards, menus, popovers, tooltips, list panels, toasts, and frames.

modal.$description: Corner radius for dialogs, sheets, and drawers.

size.$description: Ergonomic sizing scales for pointer input.

hit.$description: Minimum hit target size (0 disables padding expansion).

density.$description: Page-level row, padding, gap, and surface spacing metrics.

control.$description: Control internal geometry and switch size tier.

state.$description: Interaction state opacities, press scale, and ripple switch.

overlay.$description: M3 state-layer ink opacities: hover 0.08, focus 0.10, pressed 0.10, dragged 0.16 (StateTokens.kt).

accent-pressed-opacity.$description: Pressed opacity for accent controls when no pressed accent finish replaces it.

disabled.$description: M3 disabled controls: 0.38 content opacity with fill: true (10% onSurface container, _md-comp-button-filled.scss).

motion.$description: Interactive spring and timing physics roles.

settle.$description: M3 Expressive DefaultSpatial spring (stiffness 380, damping ratio 0.8).

control.$description: M3 Expressive DefaultEffects spring (stiffness 1600, damping ratio 1.0).

move.$description: M3 Expressive DefaultSpatial spring for layout and indicator movement.

mono.$description: Monospace font family for code blocks and numeric readouts.

size.$description: Font sizes per type role for pointer input.

line-height.$description: Unitless line-height ratios per type role for pointer input.

color.$description: Adaptive A-layer and B-layer color roles for dark appearance.
